response.sql: WITH linked AS (SELECT t.ordertypedist AS ordertypedist, COUNT(DISTINCT t.transreg) AS txn_count FROM advancedbehavior a JOIN transactionrecord t ON a.translink = t.transreg GROUP BY t.ordertypedist), shares AS (SELECT ordertypedist, txn_count, txn_count * 1.0 / SUM(txn_count) OVER () AS share FROM linked), base AS (SELECT ordertypedist, txn_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS baseline FROM shares) SELECT ordertypedist AS order_type_mix, txn_count AS distinct_transaction_count, share, share - baseline AS share_above_baseline FROM base WHERE share > baseline ORDER BY share DESC

assumptions.assumption: Records with a NULL ordertypedist form their own group (GROUP BY keeps NULL as one group), and that group counts as a mix in the total and in the baseline average.
The share's denominator is the sum of the per-mix distinct transaction counts. A transaction appears under only one mix, so this equals the total number of distinct linked transactions.
The share is a fraction between 0 and 1, not a percentage.
